In Build Mode, enable logging and enter a11y.buildcoords 5. Close the console and wait eight seconds. This diagnostic does not move the pointer or build. Then test a small house helper on a backed-up save. Install the script in Mods/TS4_Access and the standard UI there; install the UI Cheats compatibility package in Mods/_Overrides only when using UI Cheats. Keep the three files paired.
